description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) Enter a closed or closing deal as PENDING. Nothing is paid; the owner approves it in the app or with approve_deal.

commission_pct.description: Commission percent of price, e.g. 3 for 3%

gci.description: Gross commission in dollars (instead of price + commission_pct)

referral_percent.description: Referral fee as a percent of the commission (optional)

side.description: Which side the agent had: list (also seller, listing), buy (also buyer, selling-agent) or both (also dual). Any capitalisation

name: record_deal
